data.action: 跪坐茶席前，研墨的手微顿
data.description: 【夕 · 煮茶研墨】古朴清幽的茶席前，红泥小火炉上的清泉正咕嘟作响。夕跪坐于竹席上，研墨的纤细玉手微微一顿，将一盏泛着墨香的春茶推到你的面前——「尝尝看吧，这是取画中雪水煮的雨前茶。哼，要是敢说不好喝，下次就只能喝砚台里的墨汁了。」
data.promptProse: She pauses the ink stick over its stone and slides the steaming tea toward the viewer with her free hand. Soft courtyard light reaches the cup beside the red clay stove.
data.title: 夕 · 煮茶研墨
data.animaCaption: She pauses the ink stick and slides the tea toward the viewer with her free hand.
